detail.longDescription: I'm a small indie developer, I've made a mac app called Sidekins It is a small desktop character that you can design yourself(I call it a Kin/Sidekin) and lives around your screen and peeps from the side when not in use. It is a very social app, you can add your friends and chat with them using your Kin. It is an AI agent so you can ask in the main chat to delivery some message to your friend and it creates the message you want and animation using your Kin and goes to your friends desktop and speaks/act out your message. You can also ask it to help you "guide" through your mac, or any app, it moves and points around telling you how things work. There is also a "do" mode, this actually does things for you on your mac, like play this song on Spotify or add an iPhone 16 to my amazon cart. you can see the demos here on the website on what and how it does things : www.sidekins.com Currently, it works on Mac with apple silicon, and has 300 free messages. Try it out, and connect with me on the app: @18kushaljain
